items.stem: A patient asks for a copy of their record. Which concept determines exactly which documents must be released?

options.text: The definition of the legal health record
options.rationale: Correct: the legal health record defines the documents disclosed for legal and release purposes.

options.text: The size of the hard drive
options.rationale: Storage capacity is unrelated to what constitutes the legal record.
The insurer does not define the legal health record's contents.

options.text: The color of the file folder
options.rationale: This is irrelevant to record content.

items.explanation: Correct: the legal health record defines the documents disclosed for legal and release purposes.

items.stem: How do 'privacy' and 'security' differ in health information management?

options.text: Privacy governs who may access data; security is the controls that protect it
options.rationale: Correct: privacy is about permitted access/use, security is the safeguards.
They are related but distinct concepts.

options.text: Privacy applies only to paper and security only to electronic records
options.rationale: Both apply across paper and electronic records.

options.text: Security governs who may access data and privacy protects it

items.explanation: Correct: privacy is about permitted access/use, security is the safeguards.

items.stem: Select TWO systems used to classify or code healthcare data.

options.rationale: Correct: ICD-10-CM is a diagnosis classification system.
Correct: CPT codes procedures and services.
An evacuation plan is not a coding system.
A parking policy is unrelated to clinical coding.
A menu is not a health-data classification system.
